affected_version: Unpublished Goal 82 identity implementation. Exact published 0.5.2 package inventory has no identity implementation modules; this finding is not claimed against 0.5.2.
invariant: Incoming receipt self-hashes prove byte consistency, not target acceptance. Only an exact target-owned acceptance binding with target ancestry, or the own generated receipt of a verified applied local transaction, supplies replay authority.
strategy: Quarantine incoming acceptance bindings as exact inert evidence; validate receipt structure and binding bytes; persist target acceptance independently of later authored edits. This is an authored target trust namespace, not a signature or protection from an actor authorized to rewrite target state.

before.original_attack_cases: Eight genuine but unapplied self-hashed receipt cases failed before the patch: false semantic base or replay suppression across working-tree, committed, transported and reverted evidence.
before.review_regressions: Two fresh-review regressions reproduced: post-application edits before first commit lost replay acceptance in a clone or renamed target branch.
